run_speedtest: run the speedtest module to measure network evaluation time for a trained autoencoder model
run_speedtest_with_profiler: run the speedtest module with PyTorch profiler enabled and export a Chrome trace file
run_speedtest_with_scripting: run the speedtest module with TorchScript scripting enabled for the encoder and decoder
run_speedtest_no_fuse: run the speedtest module without applying the fuse optimization on the autoencoder model
run_speedtest_custom_batchsize: run the speedtest module with a custom batch size for evaluating the autoencoder
